therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Radioimmunotherapy combining anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody with beta-emitting radioisotope
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell lymphoma cell destruction via targeted radiation delivery

results.dose_information: 111In Zevalin 5 mCi with 1.6 mg Ibritumomab Tiuxetan IV on Day 1; 90Y Zevalin 0.3 or 0.4 mCi/kg IV on Day 8; Rituximab 250 mg/m2 IV on Days 1 and 8
